# Brief Introdcution

Hi everyone! I am a second year MPH candidate at Columbia Mailman's School of Public Health. With a background as an Emergency Medical Technician in Southern Deleware, I am interested in improving health equity in rural areas and focused on community-centered solutions. At Mailman, I am gaining skills in data analysis in hopes of being able to recognize gaps in inequity and addressing them.
